reviews.text:
Thank you so much for your work! My little Romy, my Pomeranian, always looks gorgeous 🐶💕 I come to you every month and I'm never disappointed! You can really see the care, gentleness, and patience you have with the animals. She always leaves looking beautiful and soft 🥰✨

I wholeheartedly recommend this groomer, both for the quality of their work and their welcoming atmosphere. Romy will be back again and again with great pleasure! 🐾❤️

The team at La Maison du Chien is simply superb!! They listen, take the time to explain everything thoroughly, and are very reassuring. My dog ​​looked beautiful with soft fur that smelled wonderful. And I had a fantastic time with their two super friendly little dogs! Thank you again and see you soon ☺️. Go there without hesitation!

A huge thank you to La Maison du Chien for the exceptional grooming of my Bichon, exactly as I wanted.

Professionalism, kindness, and care... I highly recommend La Maison du Chien; it was my first time there, and I will definitely be back.
Hello Mr. Jean Marc, thank you for grooming my cat. Magnificent work considering the condition of my cat. I've been to several groomers and never achieved a result like yours. Thank you again.

My Samoyed had his first grooming session with a very professional, reassuring, patient, attentive, and precise groomer who showered him with compliments and attention. He noticed many details, even those well hidden under his double coat. In just one hour, his fur was white again. And his little rounded paws are just too cute!
I see him almost daily, but I haven't visited him because I don't have any animals. I hope to visit him someday. My assessment of him isn't based on knowledge.

It was my first time at this groomer's with my dog, and I'm absolutely delighted with the experience. Jean-Marc was exceptional: very kind, patient, and incredibly gentle with my dog. He explained each step of the process to him, which helped put him at ease from beginning to end.
You can really feel his passion for his work and his deep respect for animals. It's rare to find someone so caring and professional. I'll definitely keep Jean-Marc as my groomer, because he's an exceptional person, always gentle and kind. 🐾✨

A warm welcome
Very attentive care for our little Bichon Frise
True professionals and artists
Our Bichon Frise has become a star
P.S. Sorry about the bite 😬
I highly recommend these groomers, you won't be disappointed
Nicole & Richard.

A huge thank you to Jean Marc for our dog Ryse. We've found his groomer for life (Ryse was abandoned at the animal shelter at 4 years old). After trying several other groomers, we took him to La Maison pour Chien on Avenue Corot in Marseille (13013). Jean Marc immediately knew how to groom Ryse without a muzzle, and after just two hours, he looked magnificent.

I highly recommend him.
Jean DAO
A fantastic grooming salon! The team at La Maison du Chien is kind, professional, and very attentive. My dog ​​came out looking beautiful and not at all stressed. I highly recommend them!
I brought my Spitz back for the first time and I'm very satisfied with their service; they are professional, attentive, and full of advice. I recommend them 1000%!

Their work was outstanding and professional, I have nothing to say, they're top-notch!
I didn't even recognize my Caprice anymore, she turned out absolutely gorgeous! 💞💞 Thank you for everything! …

I brought my Maine Coon cat to this salon for the first time. The owner is very friendly, his grooming skills are excellent, and he gives great advice.

I will recommend him to others and will definitely go back. All the best to you!

A very warm welcome, an exceptional groomer who offered to let me stay with my dog, who is usually very anxious during grooming.

I've finally found the perfect groomer for my dog ​​and will definitely be back!
I highly recommend them!

I highly recommend this groomer. He knows his job very well and takes excellent care of our four-legged companions. When my little dog leaves his salon, she looks beautiful and like a baby despite her advanced age. Well done to him!
